body.name: Interval-block certificate handle
body.construction: Starting from \((M_d)_{d=0}^T\), maintain dropout-indexed interval boundary factors and transported endpoint linear functionals; close them under pattern marginalization and addition, local conditional-kernel normalization, Markov tail transport, positive-scaling duality, strict-concavity recovery, and exhaustive support-and-rank branching. A residual state must be converted into a graph-compatible positive response-fiber obstruction rather than passed to generic quantifier elimination.
